processes:task-fa-operate-confirm-9t4dhs.plain_language_description: When the deductions stand computed, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-fa-operate-intake-xqjd8t.plain_language_name: Receive the Calculated Compensation for the Deductions

processes:task-fa-operate-transform-tud8.plain_language_name: Take Out What Must Be Taken Out
processes:task-fa-operate-transform-tud8.plain_language_description: With the compensation verified, the processing custodian does the computation itself: each person's statutory and voluntary deductions are computed from the gross under the tables and positions that govern them, and the computed withholdings are set down in the form the activity defines. worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the compliance function computes each person's statutory and voluntary deductions from the gross, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-operate-verify-8u4hey.plain_language_name: Check the Compensation Before Taking Out the Deductions

processes:task-fa-operate-verify-8u4hey.business_purpose: It exists so nobody's pay is docked on tables that were superseded.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the deduction tables a year behind and logs the defect before any taking begins.

processes:task-fa-operate-confirm-p22n49.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the paid employees await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-fa-operate-transform-bazt.plain_language_name: Pay the People What They Are Owed
processes:task-fa-operate-transform-bazt.plain_language_description: With the register verified, the processing custodian does the disbursement itself: each person's net pay is routed down its channel and paid, reconciled as it lands, and the executed payments are set down in the form the activity defines. processes:task-fa-operate-verify-aq5d2r.plain_language_name: Check the Register Before Paying the People
processes:task-fa-operate-verify-aq5d2r.plain_language_description: Before anything is paid, the verification custodian checks the register against what disbursement requires - that every net figure is confirmed and every person is on it exactly once. processes:task-fa-operate-verify-aq5d2r.business_purpose: It exists so nobody is paid twice and nobody is paid from a figure that was never confirmed.
processes:task-fa-operate-verify-aq5d2r.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the register can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a person listed twice on the register and logs the defect before any payment runs.

processes:task-fa-operate-verify-uteme6.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the records can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.
